scope: Exact operative GWI alpha1 dependency/timing/initialization proof, not another observation assembly or84-configuration comparison

firstRequests: Exact b18b5fc8731b5c966613cc6ac38c35be1ab8984a recursive Git tree, to distinguish operative tag from later tree
Exact same revision models/__init__.py for dependency acquisition instructions
Exact same revision environment_ouce-linux.yml for pinned dependencies
Exact same revision README.md only if first returned files identify needed thermal source instructions
boundedRequests.remainingRequests: Only a concrete linked/named alpha1 dependency license or source file from returned instructions/tree. No generic search, model/control data or forcing ensemble acquisition.
boundedRequests.rights: Publisher-hosted code/metadata privately retained; independently check dependency-specific rights before executing/deriving external model code. Public code visibility does not grant rights to climate/control datasets.
boundedRequests.onUnresolvedSource: Stop and save exact missing artifact/version requirements. Do not reconstruct a missing runner by pretending sibling FTmod is equivalent.

proofBeforeScoring.callContract: Source GWI creates inclusive min/max forcing-year zero emissions and forcing frames, inserts annual forcing labels, invokes run_FaIR with no explicit initial thermal state, extracts returned T without an explicit midpoint conversion.
mustProveSeparately: Initial thermal modal state and any forcing half-step initialization
Meaning of returned T coordinates: boundary, midpoint or annual mean
Handling of first annual forcing value and terminal interval
Inclusion of all three native q/d terms
proofBeforeScoring.allowedNewCheck: Dependency-ready source-qualified contract checker and exact minimal source-equation/timing checks if dependency recovered. Test impulses, steps and zero forcing only as engineering fixtures; no new historical/ensemble rerun.
proofBeforeScoring.thresholdRule: No new scientific acceptance threshold. Any numerical proof must name both compared equations and exact residuals; machine-level agreement cannot establish observational or attribution validity.
proofBeforeScoring.preservedDistinction: Prior midpoint!=exact-annual-mean result remains frozen and must not be relabelled alpha1 evidence.
proofBeforeScoring.noAttribution: No fitted offsets, GSAT scalar, headline comparison or member-share calculation.

preservation: Only new disjoint physical scripts/tests/focused JSON evidence; existing code, ledgers, protocols and prior result artifacts remain unchanged. No app/runtime/auth/collector changes, commits, publication or callbacks.
